$comment: Performance budget (feature 009-perf-budget / P1.8). Gzip KB limits on client JS weight, checked in CI by scripts/perf-budget.mjs. Set above today's real numbers so they guard growth, not fail on day one. Bump deliberately in a PR when a real increase is justified.

sharedFirstLoadJs.note: gzip of rootMainFiles + polyfillFiles from .next/build-manifest.json — the First Load JS shared by every page (current ~166 KB, 056)

totalClientJs.note: gzip of every .next/static/chunks/*.js incl. deferred chunks like three.js (current ~658 KB, 056)

shopperPageJs.note: gzip of every chunk the prerendered /about-us and /contact HTML links, heaviest page — the root layout's JS included (current ~293 KB, 056: ~46 KB less than before, when the sellers' login and session code rode along). perf-budget.mjs also fails if zod, react-hook-form or next-auth's client appear in any of them.
